title: Entering MallWorld for the first time maybe?
content: So last night I had a dream that started me out in a mall, (maybe a weird version of my normal town mall, maybe the mall, idk) and then stuff happened yada yada, and then I'm at a strange version of my school. Is this how MallWorld is? It wasn't like the ones that I have heard about, but like it's a mall and a school.
